subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should the model-activity and explicit partial-coverage card replace the current default Usage & Spend share-card narrative for all existing users?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow correctness repair: it changes the primary information hierarchy and messaging of an established export surface, which requires owner preference rather than an automated technical judgment.

options.title: Approve the new default
options.body: Accept the model-activity card and its partial-coverage disclosures as the default artifact for existing and new users.

options.title: Preserve the current default
options.body: Keep the existing card as the default and request a narrower follow-up only if an opt-in or alternate presentation is desired.

recommendation.title: Approve the new default
recommendation.body: Accept the model-activity card and its partial-coverage disclosures as the default artifact for existing and new users.

likelyOwner.reason: The owner maintained the prerequisite renderer path and has already identified default share-card direction as the remaining decision.
